privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy (effective March 20, 2026) states: 'Alpaca does not permit AI service providers to use customer personal data to train their models.' Where Alpaca uses AI for internal operations, those tools may process provided data but do not collect new categories of personal data beyond those already described.

products.name: Trading API
products.data_scope: Account data, order history, portfolio positions, market data. FINRA/SIPC regulated. ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II apply. Commission-free for US stocks and ETFs.
products.notes: Targets individual retail traders and algorithmic/quant traders. Paper trading mode available. Full audit trail on orders.

products.name: Broker API
products.data_scope: End-customer PII, trading data, account data, portfolio positions. Alpaca acts as data controller and clearing broker. Highest data sensitivity tier in the product family.
products.notes: Used by fintechs, digital wallets, robo-advisors, hedge funds, tokenization platforms. End-user PII flows through Alpaca's infrastructure. Same certifications apply but due diligence on data sub-processing should be confirmed via contract.

products.name: Market Data API
products.data_scope: Real-time and historical US stock, ETF, and crypto market data only. Minimal personal data unless combined with a trading account.
products.notes: Lower personal data risk. Free and paid tiers. Can be used independently of brokerage accounts.

products.name: MCP Server
products.data_scope: Connects AI agents (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code) to the Trading API. Processes natural language trading prompts and order parameters. Accesses portfolio, market data, and order execution.
products.notes: Privacy policy explicitly states AI providers cannot use customer data for model training. Full audit trail of AI-generated prompts and order payloads. Requires API key authentication. Paper trading mode for safe testing.

products.name: Elite
products.data_scope: Same as Trading API; designed for high-frequency and advanced algorithmic traders. Low-cost commissions.
products.notes: Same compliance posture as Trading API. Targets sophisticated traders requiring low-latency execution (1.5ms order processing).

compare.pricing_model: Trading API: commission-free for US stocks/ETFs (retail self-directed). Broker API: negotiated enterprise/institutional pricing. Market Data: free and paid tiers. MCP Server: free account entry, no minimum deposit. Elite: low-cost per-trade model.
compare.data_residency: Not publicly disclosed. Infrastructure hosted on Google Cloud Platform. US-headquartered. EU-US DPF compliant for cross-border transfers.

flags: No public DPA document found in disclosure library; enterprises should request directly via privacy@alpaca.markets
